hypothesis: Joint supervised writer/reader adaptation can turn sensitivity to partial calculations into useful fresh self-generated computation.
motivation: Unchanged B0 near-LHS reader follows many corrupted partials but correct notes lose to raw/empty overall. Writer BC alone leaves this receiver bottleneck unresolved.

model.initialization: fresh exact released weights independently in both arms

data.source: Real FineMath4plus audited source chunks, corrected arithmetic-boundary v2 publication
data.selection: Original selected256 plus first256 reserves in unchanged curator hash order, sealed before reader outcomes; no outcome filtering.
data.notes: External exact arithmetic on one proper subexpression of causal LHS; no whole answer and no true future in writer inputs.
data.known_exact_expression_overlap: 6/64 DEV documents overlap an exact whitespace-normalized expression in TRAIN512. Documents remain disjoint; all64 remain in primary denominator.

training.reduction: Each component averaged over its labels per example, then global8 mean; sum means before one ZeRO-owned reduction/clip/update.
training.order: Same seed-specific shuffled512 order per epoch; epoch2 seed+1; same ordered1024 document occurrences in both arms.
training.checkpoint_rule: Terminal128 primary;16 saved for recovery/debugging only. No best-DEV checkpoint selection.
training.qualification: Actual two-step run per arm at full target shapes, native per-rank CPU/device gates, finite gradients, nonzero parameter updates and equal sampled replica slices before scientific release.
limitations: Additional treatment labels, gradient dose and compute are explicit, not FLOPs matched.
No exact-resume path in this finite driver; partial model+optimizer+RNG states are retained but not claimed resumed.
This tests the combined supervised construction; BC and reader-loss contributions are not individually identified.

development.population: All64 fixed FineMath DEV documents, known from interface development; no official final tests.

writer_policy.stopping: First decoded LF, native EOS151643, or cap; retain every action/error/cap/empty note.
writer_policy.prompt: Exact shared train.calculation_warmstart_data.writer_prompt on causal prefix only, including fixed two partial-calculation demonstrations.
writer_policy.seeds: One frozen item-derived seed shared across B0/control/joint writers; no candidate selection or resampling.
writer_policy.content: Decode non-EOS actions; take exact text before first LF and re-encode with native tokenizer. Preserve original actions and text.

development.reader: Frozen near-LHS serialization with the same full past, generated note and exact original terminal LHS; raw unchanged, empty has identical separators/reanchor.
development.crosses: All3 writers B0/control/joint crossed with all3 readers B0/control/joint, using each saved note unchanged. Raw/empty and global fixed length-matched shuffled/unrelated controls included.
development.primary: Terminal joint-writer/joint-reader fresh own-note initial-scalar correctness minus same-reader raw.
required_contrasts: each trained own minus B0 own
development.numeric_endpoint: Frozen initial-scalar-v2; all errors/unsupported/caps without certified number remain zero. Report syntax/status coverage and inspect all scored discordances; do not call formatting-only repairs arithmetic gains.
development.likelihood: Numeric nonwhitespace, scalar joint and original natural16 log likelihood, all absolute arms and paired document bootstrap5000/seed17.
development.success_interpretation: Useful self-generated computation requires a fresh ordinary-note benefit over raw and empty, supported by actual numeric repairs/content controls. Oracle-only or raw-only reader improvements do not suffice.
development.secondary_expression_stratum: Report overlap and nonoverlap strata without changing the complete64 primary population; exploratory, small and conditional on one training seed.

downstream.population: Same existing known GSM8K TRAIN128 development questions; official TEST remains unused.
downstream.writer_prompt: Unchanged qualified GSM8K natural question-only short-calculation prompt with fixed TRAIN0..2 demonstrations for every model; cap128/T.7/G1. Disclose difference from arithmetic equals-boundary training prompt.
downstream.reader_prompt: Same qualified four-shot QA prompt for every model; answer cap256 in all modes, strict final #### numeric parser, all failures retained.
downstream.interpretation: Known TRAIN development, conditional on checkpoints; equal caps and source exposure do not establish equal latency or FLOPs.

next_if_negative: Inspect all failure types and crossed readers; do not restart long collapsed RL or choose another checkpoint from these DEV outcomes.
superseded_reason: Owner redirected to one batched full-span reader-interface oracle and >=5000-example BF16 writer/reader warmstart. The512-example pilot was never launched.
